items.label: ✨Womens Luxury Analog Watch
items.value: Lady watch uses original imported quartz movement to keep the time accurate. 35MM diameter popular diving dial, features luxury diamonds and classic Roman numerals, easy to read.

items.label: ✨Stainless Steel Lady Watches
items.value: The female wrist watch is equipped with 3 chronograph sub-dials(Timing minute,Second,24H display) and calendar window, allowing you to manage time well. 18CM (7.09in) sturdy & comfortable stainless steel strap, with adjustment tool included for easy operation.

items.label: ✨Waterproof/Luminous Watch
items.value: The women's chronograph watch waterproof up to 100 feet (30 m), it can withstand sweat, rain and water splashes, but is not suitable for bathing and swimming. With luminous hands, easy to read the time in the dark.

items.label: 🎁Fashion Women's Gift Watch
items.value: Stylish women's watches in multiple colors (pink/green/blue/silver). This watch comes in an OLEVS brand gift box, suitable for any occasion and perfect as a gift for wives, girlfriends, family, friends, on Christmas, Valentine's Day, anniversaries, birthdays, etc.

items.label: 💖OLEVE Ladies Chronograph Watch
items.value: We provide a 1-year product quality guarantee for OLEVS Ladies watches. If you have ploblems during the use of the wristwatch, please feel free to contact us. We will offer you a professional service!

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Analog Quartz Lady Watches, Chronograph Female Watches, Luxury Daimond Ladies Watches, OLEVS Women Dress Watches, Stainless Steel Business Women Watches

items.label: Crystal
